STAGE 1

Write the whole-module specification

InputClean RTL module: origen_128443.v
InstructionDescribe the whole module’s interface and observable behavior in self-contained prose.

Protocol summary; exact prompt wording is retained by the evaluation runner, not this historical import.

OutputGenerated whole-module specification (prose).
Read input: origen_128443.v · Open raw
module origen_128443 (
    input wire A,
    input wire B,
    input wire VPWR,
    input wire VGND,
    input wire VPB,
    input wire VNB,
    output wire Y
);

    reg A_reg, B_reg;
    wire Y_wire;

    // NOR gate logic
    assign Y_wire = !(A_reg | B_reg);

    // Output assignment
    assign Y = Y_wire;

    // Input registers
    always @(posedge VPWR or negedge VGND) begin
        if (!VGND) begin
            A_reg <= 1'b0;
            B_reg <= 1'b0;
        end else begin
            A_reg <= A;
            B_reg <= B;
        end
    end

    // Simulation initialization
    initial begin
        A_reg = 1'bx;
        B_reg = 1'bx;
        #20 A_reg = 1'b0;
        #20 B_reg = 1'b0;
        #20 force VGND = 1'b0;
        #20 force VNB = 1'b0;
        #20 force VPB = 1'b0;
        #20 force VPWR = 1'b0;
        #20 force VPWR = 1'b1;
        #20 force VPB = 1'b1;
        #20 force VNB = 1'b1;
        #20 force VGND = 1'b1;
        #20 B_reg = 1'b1;
        #20 A_reg = 1'b1;
        #340 A_reg = 1'bx;
        #20 B_reg = 1'bx;
        #20 release VGND;
        #20 release VNB;
        #20 release VPB;
        #20 release VPWR;
    end

endmodule
